C0110.title: Man Arrested for Operating Over 1,000 Phones to Manipulate Views and Comments
C0110.summary: News reports stated that a man was arrested for simultaneously operating more than one thousand phones to manipulate traffic and comments. The coverage showed a rented room with large numbers of phones running at the same time, reflecting a black-gray-market pattern that uses phone farms, group-control devices, or bulk accounts to create fake exposure, fake interaction, and manipulated comments, and highlighting governance pressure for live-streaming, e-commerce, and content platforms.
